import { shallowRef } from 'vue';

On reactivation the element publishes a new

The manifest, canvas, viewport, and plugin state from before deactivation are gone, because the object that held them was destroyed. Restoring it is not attempted: that would require the wrapper to own a second state surface, which it deliberately does not.
